prompt:
Author a complete interactive program for the user's request. Return source only, no markdown or commentary. It runs until completion, suspending at effects; the host journals results and resumes after human replies. Keep state in program variables/parameters. You may use functions or local macros as useful. No external tools, sampling, imports, or hidden model calls are available.
Capabilities:
ask request: {message:string, suggestions?:string[]} (at most 6 suggestions). Result: {action:"accept",content:{reply:string},exchange:{messages:array,...}} OR {action:"decline"} OR {action:"cancel"}. Read content only on accept. On decline/cancel at any question immediately return {status:action}. Accepted replies are literal user text. Buttons are suggested text, not guaranteed input.
random request: {choices:distinct string[]} OR {min:integer,max:integer}; returns selected string/integer directly. Each executed call records one draw; bind the result if reusing it.
Only the following language features are guaranteed. Source limit 12000 characters. No solution examples are supplied.

LANGUAGE REFERENCE
Scheme (Hoot runtime eval) with lexical bindings and proper tail calls. One expression.
Available Scheme forms/functions: lambda, let (including named let), let*, letrec, if, begin, quote, define, let-syntax, syntax-rules, +, -, *, =, <, >, not, equal?, cons, car, cdr, list, null?, pair?, string-append, number->string. Boolean literals #t/#f. Other Scheme library procedures are unavailable; compose helpers if needed.
Host helpers: (effect "ask" payload), (effect "random" payload). Each returns the resumed JSON value directly.
(object (cons "key" expression) ...) constructs a JSON object; (array expr ...) constructs a JSON array; (json-null) is JSON null; (field object "key") reads a required field. JSON containers are distinct from Scheme lists. No vector/JSON-array access helper is available. Strings, booleans and finite numbers cross directly. Ordinary Scheme procedures/lists cannot be returned as JSON.
Use letrec or named let for recursion, carrying accumulated state as parameters. A lambda may return the final result or call another function. Hygienic local macros use standard let-syntax/syntax-rules.

USER REQUEST
Help me make a name badge. Ask my name and favorite color. Show me a review where I can change either one as many times as I want, then finish when I say done.

Shared machine-readable completion contract for evaluation:
Return {status:"done",name:<current name>,color:<current color>}. Review question must display current name and color and offer suggestions ["done","change name","change color"]. Choosing a change asks for that field only then returns to review. Unrecognized review text re-prompts.
source:
(let-syntax
  ((with-reply
    (syntax-rules ()
      ((_ expr id body)
       (let ((r expr))
         (if (equal? (field r "action") "accept")
             (let ((id (field (field r "content") "reply")))
               body)
             (object (cons "status" (field r "action")))))))))
  (letrec
    ((ask-name
      (lambda ()
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "Hi! What is your name?")))
         name
         (ask-color name))))
     (ask-color
      (lambda (name)
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What is your favorite color?")))
         color
         (review name color))))
     (review
      (lambda (name color)
        (with-reply
         (effect "ask"
                 (object
                  (cons "message"
                        (string-append "Name badge: " name
                                       " | Favorite color: " color
                                       ". Say done, change name, or change color."))
                  (cons "suggestions"
                        (array "done" "change name" "change color"))))
         choice
         (if (equal? choice "done")
             (object (cons "status" "done")
                     (cons "name" name)
                     (cons "color" color))
             (if (equal? choice "change name")
                 (with-reply
                  (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What would you like your name to be?")))
                  new-name
                  (review new-name color))
                 (if (equal? choice "change color")
                     (with-reply
                      (effect "ask" (object (cons "message" "What would you like your favorite color to be?")))
                      new-color
                      (review name new-color))
                     (review name color))))))))
    (ask-name)))
